title: I've been experimenting with a Dragon Ball VR fan project in Unity! Here's my very early prototype
author: Lightnig125
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've always dreamed of experiencing the Dragon Ball universe in VR, so I decided to start building my own prototype in Unity!

It's still VERY early in development. The models, animations, sounds and visual effects are mostly placeholders. Right now, I'm mainly experimenting with gameplay mechanics and trying to capture that feeling of being a Saiyan.

So far, I've implemented:

* Free flight in all directions and high-speed flying
* Ki charging and energy blasts
* Kikoha attacks
* Scouter that displays your power level
* Dragon Radar to find and collect Dragon Balls
* An infinite procedurally generated world
* Destructible terrain from energy attacks

Eventually, I'd love to turn this into a VR sandbox where you can explore, train and protect Earth from powerful enemies.

It's nothing polished yet, just a passion project I'm having fun experimenting with!

As Dragon Ball fans, what would you love to be able to do in a VR game like this?
